name: Elixir of Pain
summary: In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon seeks mountain lion blood for a lethal brew. His work serves the Royal Apothecary Society’s drive to perfect the New Plague.

sections.title: A Bitter Outlook in Tarren Mill
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon finds little joy in Tarren Mill’s surroundings. From his window, the blooming meadows and brisk mountain air of Hillsbrad seem an offense to him. Like many in the Royal Apothecary Society, Lydon devotes himself to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner and the New Plague. The Society seeks to perfect this engineered scourge, meant to kill the living and bring retribution to its enemies.

sections.title: Ingredients for Misery
sections.body: Lydon seeks ingredients for his latest poisonous mixture among the animals prowling the foothills and the slopes toward the Alterac Mountains. He believes mountain lion blood has properties needed to make what he calls an Elixir of Pain. So he sends agents into the wilds to collect ten vials. The blood will support the Society’s continuing chemical trials along the contested southern front.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Elixir of Pain?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon, a Forsaken alchemist in Tarren Mill, gives the assignment. The settlement lies in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Lydon need mountain lion blood?
faq.answer: Lydon believes mountain lion blood is needed to brew a lethal mixture. He hopes the elixir will advance the Royal Apothecary Society’s plague experiments against their living enemies.

faq.q: Where can the mountain lions be found?
faq.answer: Mountain lions roam the open fields and rolling hills of Hillsbrad Foothills, and the higher bluffs leading toward the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: What is the New Plague Lydon mentions?
faq.answer: The New Plague is a biological weapon the Forsaken’s Royal Apothecary Society is developing under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner’s orders. It is meant to eradicate both the Scourge and the living.

faq.q: What comes next after completing this quest?
faq.answer: After you hand over ten vials of mountain lion blood, Apothecary Lydon begins testing his newly brewed elixir.

faq.q: Why does Lydon despise Hillsbrad's scenery?
faq.answer: As an undead servant of the Dark Lady, Lydon resents Hillsbrad’s blooming plants, fresh air, and enduring life. He wants the Society’s toxic creations to smother the living world.

angles.text: As a Forsaken traveler, you gather reagents for Apothecary Lydon in service of the Dark Lady and the Royal Apothecary Society as they claim their place in Lordaeron.
As a Horde ally, you face the grim methods of Tarren Mill’s alchemists. You help gather wild beasts’ blood to strengthen Horde footholds against nearby human threats.
